notes: Per-pair frequency record mandated by the Lead-Grid Frequency Standard (adopted 2026-07-14) § 'Enforcement'. For every REGISTERED pair (one entry per app/pair_configs/*_config.py) this records the SIGNAL's native release frequency, its publication lag, the lead axis that frequency implies (Step 1 HARD RULE), and the anchored grid (Step 3). scripts/gate_lead_axis.py asserts each pair's lead artifacts (lead tournament CSV, lead_sharpe_distribution chart, lead_correlation) sit on the axis recorded here. The load-bearing check: a DAILY-signal pair must NOT carry a MONTHLY-axis lead chart (the hy_ig class of error). signal_frequency is the classification of record; observed_winner_lead_unit is the winner_summary.lead_unit at authoring time, kept as an audit cross-check. lead_floor / publication_lag are REFERENCE metadata for scripts/gate_lead_axis.py (axis only). Since 2026-10-16 the floors ARE enforced by scripts/gate_lead_floor.py: lead_floor_effective is the strict floor on the effective lag (lead + position_shift) and lead_floor = lead_floor_effective - position_shift.
